records.instruction: Open the thin rectangular laptop carefully using the left arm.
Lift the laptop with black cover and bottom using the left arm
Lift the silver laptop using the right arm.
Grab the light brown wooden roller on the table using arms
Grab the smooth wooden roller on the table with arms.
Grab the roller with tapered tips on the table.
Grab the hammer with black handle and beat the block
Grab the silver hammer head and claw and hit the block
Pick the hammer with black handle up and hit the block
Use the right arm to press the switch with angled edges.
Activate the switch at the smooth gray base switch
Move and click the the red ON OFF labeled toggle switch
Use the left arm to grab the green bottle with white label head-up.
Grab the bottle with red screw cap from the table with the right arm
Pick up the green plastic bottle with ridged bottom carefully using the left arm
